status: 16-pose display prototype; not a complete animation set

coordinateSystem.anchor: crop-local coordinates; anchorSource is the same point in the full image

render.placement: For a target ground point (groundX, groundY) and shared scale s, draw sourceRect at destination (groundX-anchor.x*s, groundY-anchor.y*s, sourceRect.width*s, sourceRect.height*s).
render.scalePolicy: Use one scale for every pose. Do not separately fit each crop to 256x256; that introduces size flicker.
render.sourceImagePolicy: Keep the original PNG unchanged; crop and scale only at render time.

qa.measurement: Read-only alpha-component analysis, alpha>0, minimum component area 500 pixels, 4-pixel rectangle padding. Pixel threshold is used for measurement only; no pixels were altered.
limitations: Layout is not a regular 4x4 equal-cell atlas. Use explicit sourceRect values.
Ground anchors are visually checked estimates and need in-game jitter testing.
Edges have colored low-alpha artifacts; runtime cropping cannot remove artifacts within a sprite.
Character scale and facial details vary slightly between poses.
Only a few movement phases exist, especially north/south. Do not claim 109 completed frames or validated seamless cycles.
The flat style is closer to the dog reference, but visual matching remains a prototype.
